publicationMetadataPlan.creator: OpenAI built-in image generation
publicationMetadataPlan.mediaDescription: Review-only scientific algorithmic anatomical or pathology reconstruction, not a photograph, scan, histology slide, patient record, or diagnostic image
publicationMetadataPlan.sourceUse: NLM MeSH supplies controlled condition identity and scope; official NIH sources supply conservative anatomical and communication boundaries only. No source image or design is copied.

reviewStandard: Current controlled condition identity, anatomically conservative and non-diagnostic representation, non-stigmatizing communication, complete pale edge field, crop-safe geometry, and exact prompt frozen before exactly one generation call per cleared route. Observed output controls later metadata.
promotionRule: Only the six exact accepted source hashes may be promoted to metadata-bearing lossless masters, article WebP derivatives, and centered contain-mode 1200x630 social WebP derivatives.
